activity_summary: At dinner the loaf was still a finger short. You told the house the letter was gone. Alse had swept the thread. You were going back for the Sins, and you gave no errand.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the gone letter and the afternoon.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Served the loaf as it was.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Swept the thread and did not hunt the packet.

entities.name: the Candlemas letter

entities.name: the penny loaf

facets.activity: Ate the short loaf and went back to the Sins

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The letter is gone. You need not look for it on the desk.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: The string is gone with it. I swept the thread.
